body:
# 🧪 Sulfur Slimes: Caverns & Nuclear Chaos

![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5cedf6f5a08c296697a37af0781877851fd87d8f.png)

Don't let their cute faces fool you! **Sulfur Slimes** introduces a unique biome expansion for 1.20.1 packed with custom natural hazards, reactive subterranean slimes, and a destructive endgame explosive system—including fully functional **Nuclear Bombs**!

Welcome to the toxic depths of Minecraft.

---

## 🚀 Key Features

* 🌋 **The Sulfur Caverns:** Explore a brand-new underground biome lined with unique block formations, hazardous environments, and the natural habitat of custom slime species.
* ⚽ **Slime Physics & Combat:** Interact with the slimes using fully customized physics. Hitting a normal-sized slime launches it forward like a pinball! If it impacts another entity while flying, it deals heavy damage.
* ☢️ **Weaponized Slimes & Nukes:** Mine radioactive materials to craft devastating **Nuclear Bombs**. For the ultimate chaotic attack, you can manually stuff TNT or a straight-up Nuke inside a live slime and launch it toward your enemies!
* 💎 **Resource Loop:** Collect Sulfur and Cinnabar via mining world ores, scavenging the caverns, or harvesting them directly from defeated slimes.

---

## 🧼 Slime Ecology & Biology

Encounter two distinct, reactive species roaming the toxic depths:
* 🟡 **Sulfur Slimes:** Bright yellow, peaceful critters that thrive near chemical deposits.
* 🔴 **Cinnabar Slimes:** A volatile red variation found deep within the cavern ecosystem.
* *Life Cycle & Splitting:* Upon death, adult slimes split into two helpless baby slimes. These babies are completely harmless and will naturally grow back into large adults over time if left alone.

---

## ☣️ The Cavern Hazards & Ores

Surviving the Sulfur Caverns requires extreme caution due to these atmospheric threats:
* ☢️ **Potent Sulfur Blocks:** A rare and dangerous block formation. Approaching it immediately inflicts trespassers with heavy **Poison, Nausea, and Blindness**.
* 💨 **Geysers & Dripstone:** Watch your step around pressurized sulfur geysers and toxic dripstone formations hanging from the cavern ceilings.
* ⛏️ **Sulfur & Cinnabar Ore:** Core crafting components utilized to forge specialized utility items and the mod's signature high-tier nuclear weaponry.

---

## 💡 Fun Fact / Dev Lore
* ⏱️ **The 1-Hour Challenge:** This project originally started as a backport of the official Minecraft 26.2 update. However, the entire baseline content was fully coded and implemented in **under a single hour** before expanding into the massive cavern and nuclear mod it is today!

---

## ⚙️ Compatibility & Requirements
* **Minecraft Version:** 1.20.1 (Strictly Optimized)
* **Supported Loaders:** Forge
